description: Translate the Minervamon and Chibickmon misunderstanding and the rock-monster encounter.

Pukumon's
okay!♪

trouble we went

now this...

oww... Go away,

one. Is this
one with ROG,

that bad,

was trying to
break... Isn't

english: Grrrr...

english: ...Meow!!

surrounded! We
can't move
forward or
back... This
might be a
serious pinch!

english:
With one
interruption

I have no
choice... This
is goodbye,
squishy you.

english:
Hey! Who are
you?! Why did
you kidnap
Chibickmon?
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Minervamon and other character names follow the project naming style.

And what do you
mean,
kidnapped?

We were just

sis, this is
fun!

Did this
Digimon do
anything mean
to you,

Nothing mean,
